statements.statement: The service billed was mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229
The claim was denied under CO-197 for missing prior authorization
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture and characterize intermittent arrhythmic events for further management
